idea-plugin.name: Plastic Insight
idea-plugin.description:
Plastic SCM insight where you code.

Plastic Insight adds native change markers, Local Changes, byte-accurate diffs, and bounded file history to JetBrains Rider.

  • Added, modified, and deleted lines in Rider's standard gutter
  • Controlled and unversioned files in Local Changes
  • Historical revision comparison with lazy content loading
  • Exact Add to VCS and confirmed Rollback for selected items

This is a lightweight, inspector-first integration, not a complete Plastic client. Check-in, update, switch, merge, branches, shelves, locks, and administration remain in the Plastic GUI or CLI.

Requires Windows, Rider 2026.2, and the Plastic cm.exe CLI.
